name: Samba
description: Shares folders with the computers on your hotspot, on RasBeacon or on USB drives.
author: RasBeacon

settings.label: Read-only
settings.help: Computers can open its files but not change them.

afterInstall: Add a share below. Then, on a Mac, choose Go → Connect to Server and type smb://{host}; on Windows, open \\{host} in File Explorer. Log in with the username and password you chose.
